James —

Thanks for the heads up and the summary. Short answers up front:
- Retention: production runtime request logs are retained for 90 days in our S3 bucket by default; short-term indexes and hot traces are kept for 30 days. We have not purged anything from the Friday window.
- Integrity: we can produce a handback package with SHA256 checksums and an accompanying manifest; we can also sign the manifest with our KMS key if you need cryptographic attestation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment on which artifacts you want (raw request logs, aggregated token error counts, KV-cache dump samples, slow-request traces).
2) We prepare a sealed evidence bundle (tar.gz) with manifest + checksums + minimal PII redaction where required.
3) Provide a presigned S3 link and optionally ship a signed hash to your security contact.

I've looped in Monica (Customer Success) and Marcus (Platform infra) to scope the bundle and timeline. Monica — can you coordinate an exec-friendly summary? Marcus — can infra prepare the bundle with checksums and list the encryption/KMS signing options? I can draft the external cover note.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Engineering
